description: Make one or more videos for a brand as Vega, the operations manager. The opening message is the request (for example 'make 3 videos for Emochi'). Start by reading Agents/VegaOM/vega-operations-manager.md in full: it routes the batch to the designers, produces the videos in parallel, up to 8 at a time, and delivers hosted URLs. A client's assets are found through Agents/VegaOM/docs/vega-client-ledger.md under Agents/VegaOM/client-assets/<Brand>/.

requirements.name: ffmpeg
requirements.purpose: Probing, cutting and the audio mix

requirements.name: playwright-core + chromium
requirements.purpose: Agents/DesignerShared/tools/render renders stage pages with local chromium (CHROME_PATH)

requirements.name: @spira-lab/cli
requirements.purpose: Model docs only. Never used to host a file, or to submit, wait on or check a job

requirements.name: spira sign-in
requirements.purpose: Jobs and host_file run as the signed-in operator

requirements.name: openai-whisper
requirements.purpose: Word timings when no hosted transcription is used (DesignerShared/tools/make-timings.py)

requirements.name: yt-dlp
requirements.purpose: Cloner video designer fetching a source video from a link

requirements.name: faster-whisper
requirements.purpose: Faster word timings on Linux, same model (DesignerShared/tools/make-timings.py); falls back to openai-whisper

requirements.name: opencv-python-headless
requirements.purpose: Overlay tracking (DesignerShared/tools/track-overlay.py) and the lifestyle carousel's phone-screen fit and composite (LifestyleStoryCarouselDesigner/scripts/screen_fit.py, screen_composite.py)
requirements.check: python3 -c "import importlib.util, sys; sys.exit(importlib.util.find_spec('cv2') is None)"

requirements.name: numpy + pillow
requirements.purpose: Lifestyle carousel grading, status bar and image checks (LifestyleStoryCarouselDesigner/scripts, tools/lsc.py)

requirements.name: playwright (Python)
requirements.purpose: Lifestyle carousel text render and product screen capture, driving the system chromium (CHROME_PATH); no browser download

stages.title: Read the skill, ledger and brand memory; understand the request
Plan the batch and brief the designers
Produce and render the videos in parallel, up to 8 at a time
Host the videos, update the output log, write the report

outputs.description: One line per video: status and credits spent
List of {task, brand, publicUrl}, one entry per hosted video
